usdRate.note: Ngultrum is pegged at par to the Indian rupee; RMA site unreachable. cldr.json lists INR for BT, corrected to BTN.

inflation_cpi.note: August 2026 year on year, down from 6.83% in July; secondary source because the NSB CPI page could not be reached.

inflation_projection.sourceName: NSB CPI via Trading Economics; World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG
inflation_projection.note: The ngultrum is pegged to the Indian rupee, so inflation tracks India's 4% target plus a margin; Bhutan's CPI averaged about 5% over five years (3.6% in 2025, 5.5% in Aug 2026).

policy_rate.note: The RMA has no confirmed published policy rate; an interest rate corridor was still being developed with IMF help in 2025. Trading Economics lists a 'policy rate' of 5.37% (Sep 2026) that we could not confirm with the RMA, whose site failed TLS checks.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Published deposit rate sheets of two large banks; Kuensel (Mar 2026)
savings_account_rate.note: About 4.5% at most banks; up to 4.75%-5.5% on some account tiers. Savings interest is not taxed.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Published deposit rate sheets of two large banks

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Published deposit rate sheets of two large banks
fdr_1y_rate.note: 1 to under 2 years: 4.50%-6.75%; 5-year fixed deposits pay 7.75%-8.00%.

dps_rate.sourceName: Published deposit rate sheets of two large banks (recurring deposits)

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate for individuals; citizens can bid for RGoB bonds instead (see tbond_10y_rate).

tbill_91d_rate.note: RGoB treasury bills are auctioned by the RMA (open to Bhutanese persons and entities), but no recent 91-day yield was found; RMA site unreachable.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year RGoB bond series found; recent issues were 7, 10 and 12 years.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Coupon of the latest 10-year RGoB bond (Nu 1.25bn); coupons since 2020 range 3%-6.5%.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: The Bhutanese (Income Tax Act of Bhutan 2025)
tax_bank_interest.note: 10% on fixed deposit interest above Nu 400,000 a year from 1 Jan 2026; savings and recurring deposit interest is not taxed, and banks withhold provisionally (DRC notification, 29 Jul 2026).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists; RGoB bond interest is not PIT-taxable but coupons carry 5% TDS (2023 bond offer document).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme or cover amount found; RMA site unreachable.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No credit card rate cap or typical rate found.

equity_return_low.note: A small, illiquid exchange with few listed firms and a weak, patchy index record.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Royal Securities Exchange of Bhutan; bank deposit rates
equity_return_base.note: Kept below the 5.6% untaxed 1-year deposit rate plus 4 points because the local market is thin and its 10-year record weak.

equity_return_high.note: A case where dividends from hydropower and banking stocks grow with nominal GDP.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Ngultrum per US dollar (pegged to the Indian rupee)
gold_return_low.note: Dollar gold can stall for years while the rupee peg stays stable.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Ngultrum per US dollar (pegged to the Indian rupee)
gold_return_base.note: Dollar gold trend of about 4-5% plus 2-3% a year of rupee (and so ngultrum) depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Ngultrum per US dollar (pegged to the Indian rupee)
gold_return_high.note: Strong dollar gold plus faster rupee depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Short fixed deposits and savings at 4.5%, untaxed for most savers.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Bank deposit rate sheets; RGoB bond coupons
fixed_income_return_base.note: Blend of 1-year (5.6%) and 5-year (7.75%-8%) deposits and the 6.5% 10-year bond, mostly untaxed below the Nu 400,000 exemption.

fixed_income_return_high.note: Long fixed and recurring deposits at about 8%.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry life claim settlement ratio published by the RMA found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published pure-term life premium quotes found; web search budget ran out before insurer rate sheets could be checked.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Public health care is free; no typical private or referral hospital stay cost found.

health_premium_table.note: No private health insurance premium tables found.

goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI found; public care is free, so we add 1 point to the 5% inflation assumption for private and Indian referral costs.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI found; we add 2 points to the 5% inflation assumption for private and overseas study costs.

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years = expected age at death by current age minus that age; explainer only.

support_ratio.note: People aged 15-64 per person 65+, computed from the UN WPP 2024 age structure; World Bank old-age dependency 9.08 (2025) gives 11.0.

retirement_age_default.note: No statutory private-sector retirement age found; the Labour and Employment Act 2007 (s.99) gives gratuity and provident fund on retirement but leaves ages to rules. Corporate employees in NPPF follow agency rules.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: National Pension and Provident Fund, Annual Report 2024
retirement_age_government.note: Civil service normal retirement age is set by rank: 57, 59, 60 or 63; 60 shown as the middle case.

retirement_return_base.note: Kept at the typical 1-year deposit rate (about 5.6%, untaxed below Nu 400,000 of interest a year).

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Bank deposit rate sheets; RGoB bond coupons
retirement_return_high.note: Laddered 5-year deposits and RGoB bonds at 6.5%-8%.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Balanced mix of long deposits (about 6.5%), local equity (7.5%) and gold (7%).

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: Long deposits at 8% with equity and gold high cases.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension found; elderly support is through royal kidu grants. Could not confirm a source stating none.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour and Employment Act 2007 (s.99-101) entitles retiring employees to gratuity but sets the amount in rules we could not read; the formula is reportedly one month's last basic pay per year of service (unverified).

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: National Pension and Provident Fund, Annual Report 2024
public_pension_scheme.note: Civil service plan: 40% of last basic pay after at least 23 years; normal retirement age 57-63 by rank; yearly adjustment by CPI capped at 5%; minimum pension Nu 5,510. Covers civil servants, armed forces and state corporations only.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate; citizens can buy RGoB bonds.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by the RMA; open to Bhutanese persons and entities.

equity_fund.note: No retail mutual or index fund found; listed shares trade on the Royal Securities Exchange of Bhutan.

insuranceRegulator.name: Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan (insurance supervision)

insuranceComplaints.name: Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan (financial consumer complaints)

pensionScheme.name: National Pension and Provident Fund
pensionScheme.note: Covers civil servants, armed forces and state corporations; private employees use provident fund schemes.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (free public health care)
